params.body: ## Why Elixir's measurement of 2026-11-11 scored the basic tags of abovebeyond.ai at 67/100, found no robots.txt, and found that 10 of 10 measured pages have no canonical link and no og:image. A check of the live site with curl on 2026-11-13 confirms it: - `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` and `/sitemap-index.xml` all return 404. - None of the 13 built pages has `rel="canonical"`, any `og:` property or any `twitter:` tag. - What is already there: every page has a ``, a meta description, exactly one `<h1>`, `lang="en"`, and every `<img>` has an `alt`. The existing tests in `test/paginas.test.mjs` already guard titles, descriptions and the single h1. So the missing points are the canonical link, the sharing tags and the crawler files, all of which belong in one place: `src/layouts/Base.astro` is the single layout and every page uses it. ## What - **`src/layouts/Base.astro`**: adds `<link rel="canonical">`, `og:type`, `og:site_name`, `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image` (with `og:image:type`, `:width`, `:height`, `:alt`) and `twitter:card`. The canonical and `og:url` are built from `site` in `astro.config.mjs` and the page path, so they carry the trailing slash that `trailingSlash: 'always'` serves. Title and description reuse the props every page already passes. A new page gets all of this without doing anything. - **`public/abovebeyond-avatar.png`**: a copy of `brand/abovebeyond-avatar-nacht.png` (the night avatar, matching the dark site), because `brand/` is not published. It is 1024x1024. There is no brand image of 1200x630 or larger in the repository: the only wide image is `elixir-portal.webp`, a screenshot of the portal showing another site's measurements, which is not suitable as the share image of the whole site. Because the image is square, the Twitter card is `summary`, not `summary_large_image`, which would crop it. A purpose-made 1200x630 image can replace this file later without touching the layout. - **`src/pages/sitemap.xml.ts`**: a static endpoint that lists every `.astro` file under `src/pages/`, skipping what Astro does not build either (`_` files and folders, dynamic routes). It uses `import.meta.glob` with `?raw`, so the parked pages are not compiled. No new dependency: the site only has fixed pages, and `@astrojs/sitemap` would add a package and a lockfile change for the same output. - **`public/robots.txt`**: allows everything and points to `https://abovebeyond.ai/sitemap.xml`. - **`test/paginas.test.mjs`**: two tests on `dist/`. Every page in the list has a canonical equal to its own address and the og/twitter tags, and the og:image file exists in the build. robots.txt names the sitemap, the sitemap contains every page, and no parked page. Not changed: the one page Elixir flags as thin is a content question and is left alone. Five meta descriptions are longer than about 160 characters (home 248, pac-framework 228, elixir 176, proveml 171, trust 167) and search engines will cut them; that is wording, not markup, so it is not touched here. ## Checked - `npm ci` and `npm test` (build plus `node --test`): 13 pages built, `dist/robots.txt` and `dist/sitemap.xml` present, 36 tests, 35 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (the SoftHSM token test, which skips without `pkcs11-tool`). - `dist/sitemap.xml` lists the 13 built pages and none of the parked ones. - The signed blog posts: the manifest of `proveml/manifest` drops tags, so the new head tags do not change the manifest root of either post (computed with and without them: identical). Separately, and already true before this change, the roots in `public/blog/*.vc.jwt` do not match the pages as they are built and served today; re-signing needs key-1 and is not part of this pull request. - `scripts/brand-lint.mjs dist` (not part of `npm test`): no new kind of hit. Its em-dash count rises because `og:title` and `og:description` repeat the existing titles and descriptions, several of which contain an em dash (`About — AboveBeyond`). Rewording those titles would clear both. - `npm run typecheck` was not run: `@astrojs/check` is not installed in the project.
params.title: Add robots.txt, a sitemap, and canonical and Open Graph tags to every page
